title: Craftable Wither Skull's!
description: Probelly useless... But this mod will help you obtain a skull gently.
body: Thanks to this mod, crafting Wither Skeleton Heads in survival mode is now much more balanced and enjoyable. Instead of spending hours searching for a Wither head in the Nether, you can craft your own using the new recipes added by the mod. The mod is fully compatible with the 1.20.1 Forge infrastructure.
